RCA before repair (rebar-debug Phase 1):

Step 0(a): searched for `gate_status REVIEW_RESULT sidecar stale findings terminal`, `gate_status`, and `REVIEW_RESULT gate_status`; current ticket is the active report. Prior related closed bug `d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231` introduced the async gate handle/poll surface, but did not cover REVIEW_RESULT readability.
Step 0(b): ticket has no quoted version; created_at 1788332684139080595 maps to floor commit a85cb4781845ccf0d8c0375adce9a01391ba4bc8. No later changes to the suspect paths before current HEAD 384ca0dc2d7c.
Step 0(c): fresh worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/debug-gate-status-sidecar` is at 384ca0dc2d7c (= origin/main).

Design-decision check: docs/plan-review-gate.md and AGENTS.md document `review_plan_start` -> poll `gate_status(job_id)` as the long-gate workflow, with terminal `passed/failed` carrying durable attestation currency. `plan_review_verdict.schema.json` documents `sidecar_emitted`, and the ticket explicitly allows either deferring terminal visibility or adding a readability indicator. No ADR/ticket found that intentionally permits terminal-with-stale-findings; this is a defect fix honoring the documented poll contract, not a contract change.

Proven mechanism: `src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:141-178` builds a terminal poll response solely from the `.rebar/gate_runs/<job_id>` index record plus signed-attestation currency. It never checks whether the plan-review `REVIEW_RESULT` sidecar for that run exists/readable. `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:148-179` records `status=passed`/`verdict=<BLOCK|PASS>` in the run index from the returned result, and `_terminal_from_result` treats a BLOCK verdict as `passed` (completed). For BLOCK there is no signed plan-review attestation, so the existing `durable` block is `unsigned` by design and cannot distinguish “findings not readable yet” from “BLOCK has no attestation.”

Runtime proof: in a local scratch repo, I wrote an older `REVIEW_RESULT`, then recorded a terminal plan_review gate-run index for a newer job without writing a new sidecar. `gate_runs.gate_run_status(job_id)` returned `{'status':'passed','verdict':'BLOCK',...}` while `sidecar.latest_review_result(ticket)` returned the old finding (`old-finding`). This exactly reproduces the silent stale-read window.

Defect origin: introduced by commit 44ec1c2e67373a2e2b888a1beb0bf1cb7b0f6d39 (`d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231: async gate start (P2)`), which added `gate_run_status` and documented terminal `passed/failed` without a per-run sidecar-readability token. Blame/log -L on `gate_run_status` points to that new-file commit. I attempted to record an early `caused_by` link to `d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231`, but the tracker refused it because it could not find a referencing commit for the target; I will still pass `--caused-by=d80d-7be7-1c0a-4231` on bug close.

Caller-dependency gate: expected post-fix behavior is additive: plan-review `gate_status` includes whether this job’s REVIEW_RESULT findings are readable. `rg` found only MCP read registration, docs, and tests; no production caller relies on the absence of a findings-readability field. Existing status/verdict semantics remain unchanged.
